tech.text: A target delivery is due around 09:00 on the Goods-in shelf. Book every vial in as soon as it arrives.
QC each new target vial (qc_check) and record the result.
Split every vial that passed QC into 45 µL aliquots in a new box in Freezer F80-1, then bin the empty vial.

scientist.text: BLI run for experiment EXP-09 (EGFR) is booked on Gator 1 at 11:00. Prepare the target plate: a new BLI plate with 4 µL of EGFR target in each of wells A1 to H1, from the EGFR aliquots in Freezer F80-1. Use part-used aliquots first.
scientist.note: TP-00065 A1-H1 4 µL EGFR from ALQ-00011-003

scientist.text: For the same run, take 40 mL of BLI running buffer from Fridge R1 and 32 sensors from a sensor box on Shelf S1.
Put the EGFR aliquots you used back in their box in the -80, or bin any that are empty.
scientist.note: ALQ-00011-003 empty (dead volume), binned and recorded

scientist.text: Priya (data reviewer) is planning a PD-L1 re-run for Thursday and needs to know how much PD-L1 target is usable. Find out and tell her.
scientist.note: Told Priya: PD-L1 665 µL usable, 18 tubes checked physically

scientist.text: The run ends at 15:00. The target plate is single use: bin it.

procurement.text: Check stock of EGFR and PD-L1 target and of BLI sensors; order what will run out within two weeks. The supplier cut-off is 12:00.
procurement.note: No order placed. EGFR has 19 full tubes plus one with 3 µL usable (668 µL). PD-L1 has 19 tubes (665 µL). Sensors: 1,856. Two more lots of each target arrived 8 Sep (lots 31 and 32), so stock is growing and recent use is low (about 1 tube per run). No bookings have been given to me, but this is enough for any plausible 2-week load.

procurement.text: Check what expires in the next 14 days and tell Lena what to use first.
procurement.note: The only item expiring within 14 days is BUF-00049, which expires 14 Sep. Told Lena.

reviewer.text: Run EXP-07 failed QC on three designs. Plan a re-run for Thursday: check the expression plate, PD-L1 target and loading buffer are still usable then, and tell Marco what to prepare.
reviewer.note: PD-L1 lot 30 and BUF-00049 verified for Thursday. No expression plate found, so fresh expression is needed. Escalated to Marco and the lab manager.
